up: Retrieve up to 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for the human single-protein target CHEMBL1293255 (15-hydroxyprostaglandin dehydrogenase [NAD(+)]). Return the following columns: assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Apply filters for exact standard relation '=', non-null pChEMBL values, and standard type IC50. Order the results by molecule ChEMBL ID and then by assay ChEMBL ID.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.assay_chembl_id,
    td.target_type,
    td.tax_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    md.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molecule_chembl_id = md.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293255'
    AND a.standard_relation = '='
    AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
ORDER BY
    md.molecule_chembl_id,
    a.assay_chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
